actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative board
actors.private_context: The board has called a special general meeting for the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy. They know the bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout for the amendment to pass. They have sent out notices to all members.

actors.name: Sunmark housing cooperative members
actors.private_context: Each member has received notice of the special general meeting on the 12th regarding the pet policy amendment. They are aware of the meeting date and time, and that their attendance is needed to reach the required turnout.

shared_context: Sunmark housing cooperative's bylaws require a two-thirds member turnout for amendments to the pet policy. A special general meeting has been called for the 12th to vote on such an amendment. The meeting will be held at the cooperative's common room at 7 PM. Members can attend in person or by proxy.

starting_events.description: The board has sent notices to all members about the special general meeting on the 12th to vote on amending the pet policy.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least two-thirds of the cooperative's members attended the special general meeting (in person or by proxy) on the 12th. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
